title: Applied-Energistics-2 issue #8809: TheOneProbe integration doesn't work correctly on 1.21.1

text: [issue by Lauriichan] ### Describe the bug When looking at an AE2 block which stores power the tooltip is not being generated, instead a exception is thrown and TheOneProbe shows `Error: ae2:block-entity`. ### How to reproduce the bug 1. Setup a server and client with AE2 and TheOneProbe 2. Join the server and look at any AE2 block which can store energy 3. See `Error: ae2:block-entity` in the one probe 4. Opening the debug log provides a stacktrace. ### Expected behavior That the tooltip is being shown correctly ### Additional details I also investigated where this is coming from and it seems like the tooltip built on the server is accesing the client config value `powerUnit`. I suppose this would work if the server is the client (singleplayer) but as seen here it doesn't work on a server-client environment as the server never creates the client config. The reason for this issue is simply that the tooltip generation for the power related blocks use `Platform#formatPower` which in turn accesses the mentioned value. Mod versions: - AE2: 19.2.17 - TheOneProbe: 1.21_neo-12.0.8 ### Which minecraft version are you using? 1.21 ### On which mod loaders does it happen? NeoForge ### Crash log https://gist.github.com/Lauriichan/b954ecb04a767c0c00ff7d552aa42f1e [comment by Lauriichan (none)] An easy solution would probably be to just use the AE power unit. And a possibly better solution would be that the client tells the server which Power unit it has selected and the server stores that in the player data or smth like that [comment by shartte (member)] We've since removed TOP support from main, so I don't think this issue is relevant anymore to main.
